derivation: For one missing corner: area=(1-pi/4)r^2; centroid=(5/6-pi/4)/(1-pi/4)*r each axis; centered polar second moment=(2-5pi/8-2*area_factor*centroid_factor^2)r^4. Gaussian Hessian spectral norm <=1/(2pi sigma^4). Taylor remainder <=.5*Hessian*moment; sum four corners.
scope: Continuous exact Gaussian vs four corner centroid correction, radius/sigma <=.3. Excludes erf approximation, float rounding, raster antialiasing and final 8bit quantization.
